book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第二册
unit_cn: Unit 3 Times Change! 时代变迁
source: 外研社新标准选择性必修二 Unit 3 词表(p25-35 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、时代变迁/书店/新闻/改革/表情符号主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The town has changed beyond recognition in the past decade.
words.example_cn: 在过去十年里,这座小镇已经变得认不出来了。

words.example_en: The legendary old bookstore was once the heart of the neighbourhood.
words.example_cn: 这家大名鼎鼎的老书店曾是社区的中心。

words.example_en: The elderly owner found it harder and harder to run his shop.
words.example_cn: 上了年纪的店主发现经营店铺越来越难。

words.example_en: More and more young people now read e-books on a tablet.
words.example_cn: 如今越来越多的年轻人在平板电脑上读电子书。

words.example_en: I tried to find some words of sympathy for the old shopkeeper.
words.example_cn: 我努力想为那位老店主说几句同情的话。

words.example_en: A bunch of us kids used to drop by the store after school.
words.example_cn: 我们一群孩子过去常在放学后顺路去那家店。

words.example_en: He would pick the perfect book for us from a dusty shelf.
words.example_cn: 他总能从布满灰尘的架子上为我们挑出最合适的书。

words.example_en: Customers were poring over the shelves selling posters and gifts.
words.example_cn: 顾客们正仔细查看摆放海报和礼品的架子。

words.example_en: We spent hours reading on the store's old but comfortable furniture.
words.example_cn: 我们坐在店里那些陈旧却舒适的家具上读了几个小时。

words.example_en: Both the old man and his bookstore were hidden in a thick mist.
words.example_cn: 那位老人和他的书店都隐没在浓浓的雾霭中。

words.example_en: The shop's old brick exterior had not changed at all.
words.example_cn: 这家店那古旧的砖砌外墙一点也没变。

words.example_en: Outside, the brick exterior looked the same, but inside it was a different world.
words.example_cn: 外面的砖墙外观依旧,里面却是另一番天地。

words.example_en: Nearby, customers were looking at shelves selling stationery and posters.
words.example_cn: 旁边,顾客们正在看摆着文具和海报的货架。

words.example_en: Under Jennifer's leadership, the bookstore became a place to get together.
words.example_cn: 在珍妮弗的领导下,这家书店成了人们相聚的地方。

words.example_en: The new café in the bookstore sells healthy organic food.
words.example_cn: 书店里新开的咖啡馆售卖健康的有机食品。

words.example_en: The store now holds jazz concerts and movie nights for the community.
words.example_cn: 这家店如今为社区举办爵士音乐会和电影之夜。

words.example_en: Creativity has brought my humble bookstore into the 21st century.
words.example_cn: 创意把我这简陋的小书店带进了21世纪。

words.example_en: Small shops find it hard to compete with large chain stores.
words.example_cn: 小店很难与大型连锁店竞争。

words.example_en: This sentence is used to emphasise the process rather than the result.
words.example_cn: 这个句子用来强调过程而非结果。

words.example_en: People were doing reconstruction work on the old market last week.
words.example_cn: 上周人们正在对那座旧市场进行重建。

words.example_en: While all this was going on, a journalist was taking photos.
words.example_cn: 当这一切正在发生时,一位记者在拍照。

words.example_en: The reform led the country into a new era of prosperity.
words.example_cn: 这场改革把国家带入了一个繁荣的新时代。

words.example_en: The reform and opening-up policy has changed Chinese society greatly.
words.example_cn: 改革开放政策极大地改变了中国社会。

words.example_en: The policy paved the way for the country to become modern.
words.example_cn: 这项政策为国家走向现代化铺平了道路。

words.example_en: The journey is paving the way for a fully modernised socialist country.
words.example_cn: 这段历程正在为一个全面现代化的社会主义国家铺平道路。

words.example_en: China continues to develop further alongside other countries.
words.example_cn: 中国继续与其他国家一起向前发展。

words.example_en: The Belt and Road Initiative means a new dawn for trade between countries.
words.example_cn: “一带一路”倡议意味着国家间贸易的新曙光。

words.example_en: The park formed a solid basis for future business development.
words.example_cn: 这个园区为未来的商业发展打下了坚实的基础。

words.example_en: Shenzhen was the first special economic zone in China.
words.example_cn: 深圳是中国第一个经济特区。

words.example_en: On the form, she wrote down her occupation as a teacher.
words.example_cn: 在表格上,她把职业一栏填成了教师。

words.example_en: While waiting outside the cafeteria, I received a strange message.
words.example_cn: 在自助餐厅外等候时,我收到了一条奇怪的消息。

words.example_en: Today people often communicate with emojis instead of words.
words.example_cn: 如今人们常常用表情符号而非文字来交流。

words.example_en: Emojis are becoming an integral component of the language we use.
words.example_cn: 表情符号正成为我们所用语言中不可缺少的组成部分。

words.example_en: Pictures have become a key component of online messages.
words.example_cn: 图画已成为网络消息的一个关键组成部分。

words.example_en: Emojis come in different categories, such as faces, animals and food.
words.example_cn: 表情符号分为不同类别,如表情、动物和食物。

words.example_en: New emojis expand the way in which we communicate every year.
words.example_cn: 每年都有新的表情符号拓展着我们交流的方式。

words.example_en: People like emojis because they add emotional meaning to a message.
words.example_cn: 人们喜欢表情符号,因为它们给信息增添了情感意味。

words.example_en: Using emojis is similar to the gestures we make when we speak.
words.example_cn: 使用表情符号就像我们说话时做的手势。

words.example_en: The intention of these new versions is to attract young readers.
words.example_cn: 这些新版本的意图是吸引年轻读者。

words.example_en: The adaptation replaced some of Shakespeare's words with emojis.
words.example_cn: 这个改编版用表情符号替换了莎士比亚的一些词句。

words.example_en: The aim is to make the classics more accessible to young readers.
words.example_cn: 其目的是让经典作品对年轻读者来说更易懂。

words.example_en: Some people feel the new versions have lost the heart and soul of the plays.
words.example_cn: 有些人觉得这些新版本失去了戏剧的精髓。

words.example_en: Emojis have a tendency to pop up all over the place these days.
words.example_cn: 如今表情符号有到处冒出来的趋势。

words.example_en: Users say that emojis facilitate the way in which we communicate.
words.example_cn: 使用者说表情符号让我们的交流方式更加便利。

words.example_en: Some educators worry that we are losing the ability to write properly.
words.example_cn: 一些教育工作者担心我们正在失去好好写字的能力。

words.example_en: To many young users, spelling has become of secondary importance.
words.example_cn: 对许多年轻用户来说,拼写已变得次要了。

words.example_en: In the comics, Clark Kent would change into his Superman costume in a phone box.
words.example_cn: 在连环漫画里,克拉克·肯特会在电话亭里换上超人服装。

words.example_en: He used to pop into a phone box to change into his costume.
words.example_cn: 他过去常钻进电话亭去换上他的服装。

words.example_en: Even if we needed to call someone urgently, we would borrow a mobile phone.
words.example_cn: 即使我们急需给某人打电话,也会借一部手机。

words.meaning_cn: 有说服力的;令人信服的
words.example_en: The writer gives several convincing reasons why phone boxes are disappearing.
words.example_cn: 作者给出了几个有说服力的理由来解释电话亭为何正在消失。
